title: Roco Kingdom 国际服 CBT 注册指南：预约、平台与语言说明
titleEn: Roco Kingdom CBT Registration Guide: Sign-up, Platforms, and Languages
summary: Roco Kingdom（洛克王国：世界）国际服首测 CBT 将于 2026-10-27 开启，报名窗口为 8/26–10/20，本文整理报名入口、必填问卷、推荐机制、CBT 可玩平台与语言说明。
summaryEn: Roco Kingdom global CBT starts on October 27, 2026, with sign-ups open from August 26 to October 20. This guide covers the registration page, mandatory questionnaire, referral system, CBT platforms, and languages.
content:
## Roco Kingdom 国际服 CBT 注册指南

《洛克王国：世界》（Roco Kingdom，海外大陆 Carosia）国际服首测 CBT（官方测试名 “Quack Quack Test”）将于 **2026-10-27** 开启，**报名窗口为 2026-08-26 至 2026-10-20**，目前在官网 rocokingdom.com 可报名。

### 报名步骤

1. 前往官网 rocokingdom.com，点击 “Join the Test”。
2. **必填报名问卷**：填写偏好的游玩环境、计划使用的设备等信息，问卷提交是获得资格的前提。
3. 通过专属邀请链接邀请好友完成预注册，被邀请人数越多，入选优先级越高（邀请不替代本人的问卷提交）。
4. 保存报名确认信息，等待 CBT 资格通知。

### CBT 可玩平台（2026-10-27 首测）

| 平台 | CBT 状态 |
| --- | --- |
| Windows (PC) | 可玩 |
| iOS | 可玩 |
| Android | 可玩 |

### 正式版平台（CBT 之外）

完整版将登陆 Windows PC、PlayStation 5、Xbox Series X|S、iOS、Android。PC 版计划上架 **Steam、Epic Games Store、Microsoft Store**；PlayStation 5 版已有 PS Store 页面。Steam 页面目前锁国区，请以国际服商店为准。

### 语言支持

- 字幕：官方称国际服支持繁中、英、日等 18 种字幕。
- 配音：仅英 / 日。
- 国际服无简中，国服数据与国际服数据独立不互通。

### 常见问题

**CBT 资格如何发放？**
一般通过报名邮箱分批发放，报名问卷完整度与被邀请人数会影响入选优先级，具体规则以官方公告为准。

**报名截止到什么时候？**
2026-10-20。建议尽早提交问卷并保留确认信息。

**国服玩家能玩国际服吗？**
国际服与国服数据独立，国服玩家如需体验国际服需使用国际服账号并遵守当地平台规则。

**这是付费测试吗？**
官方强调 Roco Kingdom 非 Pay-to-Win，CBT 具体付费/删档规则以官方公告为准。
contentEn:
## Roco Kingdom Global CBT Registration Guide

_Roco Kingdom_ (洛克王国：世界, set on the overseas continent Carosia) is developed by Tencent's Morefun Studios. The global CBT — officially named the “Quack Quack Test” — starts on **October 27, 2026**, with **sign-ups open from August 26 to October 20, 2026** on the official site.

### How to sign up

1. Visit rocokingdom.com and open the “Join the Test” page.
2. **Complete the mandatory questionnaire**: state your preferred play environment and planned device. The questionnaire is required for eligibility.
3. Invite friends through your unique referral link; more friends who finish pre-registration can raise your selection priority (referrals do not replace your own questionnaire).
4. Save your confirmation and wait for CBT invitation emails.

### Playable platforms for the October 27 CBT

| Platform | CBT status |
| --- | --- |
| Windows (PC) | Playable |
| iOS | Playable |
| Android | Playable |

### Full-release platforms

The full game targets Windows PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, iOS, and Android. The PC version is listed for Steam, the Epic Games Store, and the Microsoft Store; a PlayStation 5 store page is live. The Steam page is currently geo-restricted for CN — use the international store.

### Languages

- Subtitles: the global version supports 18 subtitle languages including Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.
- Voice: English and Japanese only.
- The international version excludes Simplified Chinese; global and CN server data are separate.

### FAQ

**How are CBT invites distributed?**
Usually in batches via your registration email. Questionnaire completeness and referral counts can affect priority; follow official announcements.

**When does sign-up close?**
October 20, 2026. Submit your questionnaire early and keep the confirmation.

**Can CN players join the global CBT?**
Global and CN servers are separate. CN players need a global account and must follow local platform rules.

**Is the CBT pay-to-win?**
The publisher emphasizes Roco Kingdom is not pay-to-win; exact CBT monetization/wipes follow official announcements.

title: Roco Kingdom 御三家选择指南：Sparka、Meewee、Cerulla 怎么选
titleEn: Roco Kingdom Starter Guide: Sparka, Meewee, or Cerulla?
summary: 国际服御三家为草系 Meewee、火系 Sparka、水系 Cerulla。本文结合国服开荒经验，从开荒速度、生存能力与后续捕捉三个角度给出选择建议。
summaryEn: The international starters are the Grass-type Meewee, Fire-type Sparka, and Water-type Cerulla. This guide compares early-game pacing, survivability, and availability so you can choose wisely.
content:
## Roco Kingdom 御三家怎么选

国际服开局三选一的御三家为：**草系 Meewee（叶猫）、火系 Sparka（火牛）、水系 Cerulla（水泡）**。三只均为满资质，未被选中的御三家后续可以在好友的世界中捕捉。

### 三只对比

| 御三家 | 属性 | 定位 | 开荒特点 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sparka | 火 | 快速输出 | 伤害直接，前期打野与 NPC 效率高，克草系 |
| Meewee | 草 | 续航型 | 每回合回能量，持久战强，克水系 |
| Cerulla | 水 | 坦克型 | 水泡盾 + 水炮循环，生存能力优秀，克火系 |

### 怎么选

- **想快速开荒**：选 Sparka，火系前期压制面广，打怪和推剧情节奏最快。
- **想要稳定生存**：选 Cerulla，坦度高，遇到火系外的多数敌人不容易翻车。
- **喜欢持久战**：选 Meewee，草系续航优秀，首领化（Alpha）后强度可观。

### 注意事项

- 御三家不是唯一选择：国服公测后还提供了迪莫等后期强力精灵兜底，前期不必过度纠结。
- 未选择的御三家可以去好友的世界捕捉，路线容错高。
- 国际服 CBT 的具体进化链、技能表与种族值以官方图鉴为准，本文先按官方预览稿整理。
contentEn:
## Roco Kingdom Starter Guide

At the start of the journey you choose one of three starters: **Meewee (Grass-type leaf cat), Sparka (Fire-type ox), or Cerulla (Water-type blob)**. All three start at full aptitude, and the starters you do not pick can later be caught in friends' worlds.

### Comparison

| Starter | Type | Role | Early-game note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Sparka | Fire | Fast offense | Direct damage, clears early mobs and NPCs fast; beats Grass |
| Meewee | Grass | Sustained fighter | Recovers energy each turn, strong in long fights; beats Water |
| Cerulla | Water | Tank | Bubble shield + water cannon loop, excellent survivability; beats Fire |

### Which one should you pick?

- **Fastest early progression**: Sparka. Fire has wide early coverage and the quickest story/NPC pacing.
- **Most stable survivability**: Cerulla. Great bulk, rarely flips in fights outside Water counters.
- **Best in sustained fights**: Meewee. Grass sustain shines in longer battles and its Alpha form is strong later.

### Notes

- The starter is not your only ace: the CN launch later featured strong late-game Jinies such as Dimo as a safety net, so do not overthink the choice.
- Unpicked starters can be caught in friends' worlds, so the route has plenty of flexibility.
- CBT-specific evolution lines, skill sets, and base stats follow the official codex; this guide reflects official previews.

summaryEn: Roco Kingdom is a free-to-play open-world creature-collector from Tencent's Morefun Studios. You play as a Roco — a magic-academy student — catching 400+ creatures called Jinies across Carosia, with cross-platform co-op and turn-based PvP.
content:
## Roco Kingdom 是什么游戏

Roco Kingdom（洛克王国：世界）是腾讯魔方工作室（Morefun Studios）开发的**免费、开放世界、精灵收集**游戏，玩家扮演魔法学院学生 **Roco**，在 **Carosia** 大陆捕捉、培养并指挥精灵 **Jinies**。

### 核心设定

- **400+ 只 Jinies**：每只都有独立的身高、体型与体重，同种精灵也各不相同。
- **生态化开放世界**：不同生物群系塑造精灵的栖息与行为（例如毒系精灵会喷出毒泡形成环境危害）。
- **魔法学院设定**：玩家进入学院学习成为魔法师，剧情围绕学院生活与大陆冒险展开。

### 玩法构成

- **捕捉与养成**：使用 Buddy Pods 捕捉精灵，通过捕捉、训练、进化组建队伍。
- **回合制 PvP**：基于属性克制、队伍构成与体力管理，官方强调**无 Pay-to-Win**、无抽卡。
- **跨平台联机**：PC、主机、移动端玩家可组队冒险、共同骑行、拜访家园与种田。

### 背景信息

- 开发商：腾讯魔方工作室（Morefun Studios），代表作《Arena Breakout》。
- 国服 2026-03 上线，13 小时内突破 1500 万玩家，首月日均 DAU 超 1300 万。
- 国际服 2026-08 科隆游戏展官宣，CBT 定于 2026-10-27，正式发售日待定。
- 国际服与国服数据独立，国际服支持繁中/英/日等 18 种字幕。
contentEn:
## What Is Roco Kingdom?

Roco Kingdom (洛克王国：世界) is a **free-to-play open-world creature-collector** developed by Tencent's Morefun Studios. You play as a **Roco** — a student at the magic academy — catching, training, and commanding creatures called **Jinies** across the continent of **Carosia**.

### Core setting

- **400+ unique Jinies**: every creature varies in height, size, and weight, so even the same species feels one-of-a-kind.
- **Living ecosystems**: biomes shape where and how Jinies live — for example, Poison-type Jinies can spray toxic bubbles that become environmental hazards.
- **Magic-academy story**: you enroll to become a mage, with a narrative-driven campaign around academy life and continent-wide adventure.

### Gameplay pillars

- **Catch and raise**: capture Jinies with Buddy Pods, then train, evolve, and build your team.
- **Turn-based PvP**: battles are decided by elemental matchups, team composition, and stamina management — the publisher stresses **no pay-to-win** and no gacha.
- **Cross-platform co-op**: party up across PC, console, and mobile, co-ride Jinies, visit homes, and farm together.

### Background

- Developer: Tencent's Morefun Studios (Arena Breakout).
- The CN version launched March 2026, passing 15 million players in 13 hours and averaging over 13 million DAU in its first month.
- The international version was revealed at gamescom August 2026; the CBT starts October 27, 2026, with the full release date TBA.
- Global and CN server data are separate; the global version supports 18 subtitle languages including Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese.

## Roco Kingdom 平台与下载指南

下载入口**以官网 rocokingdom.com 为准**。注意区分 **CBT 可玩平台**与**正式版平台**：10/27 首测只有 PC、iOS、Android 三端可玩，PS5/Xbox/Steam/Epic 是正式版平台，不要混淆。

## Roco Kingdom Platforms and Download Guide

Always start from the **official site rocokingdom.com**. Keep the **CBT platforms** and **full-release platforms** separate: the October 27 CBT is playable only on PC, iOS, and Android; PS5, Xbox, Steam, and Epic belong to the full release.

### Full-release platforms

- **PC**: Steam, Epic Games Store, Microsoft Store. The Steam page is currently geo-restricted for CN.
- **Console**: PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S. A PS5 store page is already live.
- **Mobile**: iOS, Android.

### Download notes

- **No Simplified Chinese**: the international version excludes zh-CN; UI follows Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, and more.
- **Separate data**: global and CN server data are independent; CN players cannot carry CN progress into the global version.
- **Account**: register a global account and complete the sign-up questionnaire. CBT invites, builds, and update methods follow official emails and site notices.
- **Specs and size**: exact CBT specs and package size are not yet announced. As an open-world creature-collector, expect meaningful storage and a stable connection.

title: Roco Kingdom Jinies 图鉴入门：血统、特殊形态与捕捉方式
titleEn: Roco Kingdom Jinies Guide: Bloodlines, Special Forms, and Catching
summary: Jinies 是 Carosia 大陆的精灵，官方已确认超过 400 只。本文介绍 Jinies 的体型差异、18 种元素、血统（Bloodline）系统、Alpha/Exotic 特殊形态与 Buddy Pods 捕捉方式。
summaryEn: Jinies are the creatures of Carosia, with 400+ species confirmed. This guide covers size variation, the 18 elements, the Bloodline system, Alpha/Exotic special forms, and catching with Buddy Pods.
content:
## Roco Kingdom Jinies 图鉴入门

**Jinies（精灵）** 是 Carosia 大陆上生活的小精灵，官方确认正式版将超过 **400 只**。它们是本作的核心收集对象，玩法覆盖捕捉、养成、进化、对战与联机互动。

### 基本设定

- **个体差异**：每只 Jinies 的身高、体型、体重都不同，同一物种也可能遇到特殊外观个体（如棱镜光辉、异色、被 Nightmare 腐化的形态）。
- **生态行为**：不同精灵有自己的行为树——例如 Catapawn 受惊会缩进壳里，Blazehound 会对闯入领地的玩家咆哮，Dustler 会帮忙清理玩家的帽子。
- **元素（Type）**：已确认至少 **18 种元素**，包含 Shadow（影）、Wing（翼）、Common（普通）等，对应宝可梦中的幽灵/飞行/普通等类型。

### 血统（Bloodline）系统

每只 Jinies 除了主属性，还有一个副血统（Bloodline）：

- **可更换**：玩家可以改变精灵的血统，从而习得其他元素系的技能，在对战中弥补被克制的劣势。
- **Alpha 血统**：部分精灵可临时变身为更强的 boss 级形态，机制接近宝可梦的 Mega/Gigantamax。
- **Exotic 血统**：可遭遇被 Nightmare 腐化的特殊精灵，是更具原创性的特殊形态。

### 捕捉方式

- 使用 **Buddy Pods（伙伴球）** 捕捉野生精灵，机制接近传统精灵球。
- 对精灵好，它们会带礼物回来；虐待它们会逃跑、哭泣甚至用头撞你。
- 未选择的御三家可以在好友的世界中捕捉。

### 已曝光精灵（截至 2026-08）

官方预告与媒体预览中已确认：御三家 **Meewee（草）、Sparka（火）、Cerulla（水）**，以及野外精灵 **Blazehound（火系狼）、Catapawn（水系龟）、Dustler（普通系扫帚精灵）**。Sparka 的最终进化为 Pyreon，Pyreon 可 Alpha 化变为 Blazion。其余精灵名单与进化链待 CBT 官方图鉴公布。
contentEn:
## Roco Kingdom Jinies Guide

**Jinies** are the creatures living across Carosia — over **400 species** confirmed for launch. They are the heart of collection, raising, evolution, battling, and social play.

### Basics

- **One-of-a-kind variation**: every Jinie differs in height, build, and weight. Special individuals exist with prism-like radiance, alternate colors, or forms corrupted by Nightmares.
- **Living behavior**: species have behavior trees — Catapawn hides in its shell when startled, Blazehound growls at players who enter its territory, and Dustler politely cleans your avatar's hat.
- **Types**: at least **18 elements** are confirmed, including Shadow, Wing, and Common (comparable to Ghost, Flying, and Normal types).

### Bloodline system

Each Jinie has a secondary Bloodline alongside its main type:

- **Changeable**: you can swap a Jinie's Bloodline to learn skills from another element class, covering bad matchups in battles.
- **Alpha Bloodline**: some Jinies can temporarily transform into stronger boss-level forms — a middle ground between Mega Evolution and Gigantamax.
- **Exotic Bloodline**: corrupted Nightmare Jinies, a more original take on special forms.

### Catching

- Capture wild Jinies with **Buddy Pods**, the game's take on monster balls.
- Treat Jinies well and they bring gifts; mistreat them and they run, cry, or headbutt you.
- Unpicked starters can be caught in friends' worlds.

### Revealed Jinies (as of August 2026)

Official trailers and press previews confirmed the starters **Meewee (Grass), Sparka (Fire), and Cerulla (Water)**, plus wild species **Blazehound (Fire-type wolf), Catapawn (Water-type turtle), and Dustler (Normal-type broom)**. Sparka's final evolution is Pyreon, which can Alpha-transform into Blazion. The full roster and evolution lines await the official CBT codex.

至少 18 种元素，含 Shadow/Wing/Common。

At least 18 elements including Shadow, Wing, Common.
Changeable Bloodlines, Alpha forms, Buddy Pods catching.

title: Roco Kingdom 战斗系统指南：回合制、体力条与元素克制
titleEn: Roco Kingdom Battle System Guide: Turn-Based Combat, Stamina, and Matchups
summary: Roco Kingdom 的战斗为回合制：每只精灵 4 个技能、星级体力条、克制关系可见。本文解析体力管理、换人预判、血统技能覆盖与 PvP 等级标准化机制。
summaryEn: Roco Kingdom battles are turn-based: four skills per Jinie, a star-based stamina bar, and visible matchup hints. This guide breaks down stamina management, switch prediction, Bloodline coverage, and normalized PvP levels.
content:
## Roco Kingdom 战斗系统指南

Roco Kingdom 采用**传统回合制战斗**，上手简单但 PvP 有深度：每只精灵 4 个技能，攻击会消耗体力，属性克制关系在战斗中直接可见。

### 基础规则

- **回合制**：双方轮流行动，每只 Jinie 携带 4 个技能。
- **星级体力条（Stamina）**：每次攻击消耗一定体力，体力见底时必须花一回合休息恢复。
- **克制可见**：选技能时能直接看到该攻击对敌人是否命中弱点，无需背克制表。
- **等级标准化（PvP）**：对战精灵等级会标准化，胜负更多取决于元素克制、队伍构成与操作，而不是单纯的数据碾压。

### 进阶技巧

- **体力管理**：对方如果选择换人，你可以预判并在该回合休息，抢占下回合的行动优势。
- **血统覆盖**：通过更换精灵的 Bloodline 血统，习得其他元素系技能来弥补不利克制。
- **队伍构成**：不同职业/属性精灵搭配应对多类敌人，PvP 围绕职业相克展开。

### PvP 特色

- 官方强调 **无 Pay-to-Win**：没有氪金抽卡，胜负由策略、队伍与临场判断决定。
- 所有 Jinies 都能通过正常游玩获得，不存在只能靠付费获取的强力精灵。

> 说明：CBT 具体技能表、克制数值与种族值以官方图鉴为准，本文先按官方预览稿与媒体试玩整理。
contentEn:
## Roco Kingdom Battle System Guide

Roco Kingdom uses **classic turn-based combat** — easy to pick up, with real depth in PvP: four skills per Jinie, attacks that consume stamina, and matchup hints shown directly in battle.

### Core rules

- **Turn-based**: both sides act in turns; each Jinie carries four skills.
- **Star stamina bar**: each attack costs stamina. When the bar runs low, you must spend a turn resting to recover.
- **Visible matchups**: before attacking you can see whether a move hits the enemy's weakness — no need to memorize the type chart.
- **Normalized levels (PvP)**: battle levels are standardized, so outcomes lean on elemental matchups, team composition, and play rather than stat gaps.

### Advanced tips

- **Stamina play**: if the opponent switches, predict it and rest on that turn to seize tempo.
- **Bloodline coverage**: change a Jinie's Bloodline to learn skills from another element class and cover bad matchups.
- **Team building**: mix classes and elements to handle diverse threats; PvP revolves around class matchups.

### PvP notes

- The publisher stresses **no pay-to-win**: no gacha, no paid power; battles are decided by strategy, composition, and reads.
- Every Jinie can be obtained through normal play — none are locked behind payments.

> Note: exact skill sets, matchup values, and base stats follow the official CBT codex; this guide reflects official previews and press hands-on.

体力条用星表示，攻击消耗体力。

title: Roco Kingdom 联机与社交指南：跨平台组队、共同骑行与家园
titleEn: Roco Kingdom Co-op and Social Guide: Cross-Platform Parties, Co-Riding, and Homes
summary: Roco Kingdom 强调社交玩法：跨平台组队冒险、共同骑行精灵、拜访与装饰家园、一起种田和友好决斗。本文整理联机功能清单与入坑建议。
summaryEn: Roco Kingdom puts social play first: cross-platform party-ups, co-riding Jinies, visiting and decorating homes, farming together, and friendly duels. This guide lists every co-op feature and gives onboarding tips.
content:
## Roco Kingdom 联机与社交指南

Roco Kingdom 的联机是**跨平台互通**的：PC、主机、移动端玩家可以在同一个世界中组队冒险，社交系统贯穿家园、骑行、种田与决斗。

### 联机功能清单

- **跨平台组队**：PC、主机、手机玩家无需分开服务器即可组队，移动端可无缝加入 PC/主机朋友的会话。
- **共同骑行（Co-riding）**：可以一起骑乘精灵在大陆旅行。
- **家园系统**：建造与装饰自己的家园，邀请朋友参观；也可以互相拜访。
- **种田**：与朋友一起种田，共享玩法体验。
- **友好决斗**：与好友进行友好对战。
- **资源与经验共享**：联机会话中收集的奖励与战斗经验会共享。

### 单人体验

- 游戏完全支持单人游玩，不想组队也能顺畅推进主线。
- 未选择的御三家可以在好友的世界中捕捉，社交也能反哺收集进度。

### 入坑建议

- **CBT 阶段**：先确认跨平台组队与基础社交功能是否如预告所示，再决定长期主玩平台。
- **平台选择**：如果好友主要在手机上玩，PC 端也能直接加入，无需重复选择。

> 说明：国际服 CBT 的联机服务器规则、好友上限与账号绑定细节以官方公告为准。
contentEn:
## Roco Kingdom Co-op and Social Guide

Roco Kingdom's online play is **fully cross-platform**: PC, console, and mobile players can party up in one shared world, with social systems across homes, co-riding, farming, and duels.

### Co-op features

- **Cross-platform parties**: PC, console, and mobile players group up without separate servers; mobile players can join PC/console friends seamlessly.
- **Co-riding**: ride a Jinie together while traveling the continent.
- **Homes**: build and decorate your home, invite friends to visit, and visit theirs.
- **Farming**: farm together with friends.
- **Friendly duels**: battle friends in friendly matches.
- **Shared rewards**: rewards and battle experience gathered in co-op sessions are shared.

### Solo play

- The game fully supports solo play; you can push the story without a group.
- Unpicked starters can be caught in friends' worlds, so social play feeds collection progress too.

### Tips

- **During CBT**: verify cross-platform parties and social features work as previewed before committing to a main platform.
- **Platform choice**: if your friends are mostly on mobile, the PC client can still join them directly.

> Note: international CBT server rules, friend caps, and account-linking details follow official announcements.

faq.question: Can I play Roco Kingdom solo?
faq.answer: Yes. The game fully supports solo play; co-op is optional and feeds collection progress (e.g., catching unpicked starters in friends' worlds).

content:
## Roco Kingdom 预约奖励与资格 FAQ

国际服预注册已在官网 rocokingdom.com 开放。**国际服具体预约奖励尚未公布**（截至 2026-08-27），本文持续跟踪，先整理已知的资格与规则。

### 高频问题

**预注册能拿什么奖励？**
国际服具体奖励未公布。参考国服经验，国服公测曾提供预约精灵蛋（燃了鸭）与全套外观等奖励，国际服以官方公告为准。

**预注册 = 获得 CBT 资格吗？**
不等于。CBT 资格通过报名问卷筛选，预注册与问卷是两件事，两者都完成更稳妥。

**CBT 会删档吗？**
删档规则官方尚未明确说明。多数封闭测试会删档或重置，以官方公告为准。

**国际服有简中吗？**
没有。国际服支持繁中、英、日等 18 种字幕，配音仅英/日。国服与国际服数据独立。

**正式版什么时候出？**
尚未公布。CBT 于 2026-10-27 开启，正式发售日以官方公告为准。

### 跟踪项（watch/monitor）

- 国际服预约奖励内容与发放方式
- CBT 删档/保留规则
- 正式发售日与首发平台最终名单
contentEn:
## Roco Kingdom Pre-Registration Rewards FAQ

International pre-registration is open at rocokingdom.com. **Specific global pre-registration rewards are not announced yet** (as of August 27, 2026); this page tracks them and covers what is already known.

### Common questions

**What rewards come with pre-registration?**
Global rewards are not announced. For reference, the CN launch offered a pre-registration Jinie egg (Ranye Duck) with a full cosmetic set; international details follow official announcements.

**Does pre-registration guarantee a CBT invite?**
No. CBT invites are selected via the sign-up questionnaire. Pre-registration and the questionnaire are separate — complete both to be safe.

**Will the CBT wipe progress?**
Wipe rules are not officially specified. Most closed tests wipe or reset; follow official announcements.

**Does the international version have Simplified Chinese?**
No. It supports 18 subtitle languages including Traditional Chinese, English, and Japanese, with English/Japanese voice acting. Global and CN data are separate.

**When is the full release?**
Not announced. The CBT starts October 27, 2026; the full release date follows official announcements.

### Watch / monitor

- Global pre-registration reward details and delivery
- CBT wipe/retention rules
- Full release date and final platform list
